item.title: Daylight Saving Time Begins Sunday
item.description: It happens twice a year, a change of the clocks for the beginning and end of Daylight Saving Time. The change in the spring takes place at 2:00 am on the 2nd Sunday in March. That means this weekend, we will SPRING forward. At 2:00 am Sunday, we officially move our clocks FORWARD one hour. […]
